_comment: Per-fixture expectations for the agreements (WMP) harness. Key = filename in configurations/woodland/gas/test-data/. accepted:false => the WMP handler rejects the event (no agreement created, no status event); errorContains asserts the specific rejection reason appears in the app log. accepted:true => a 'versions' doc (status 'offered', agreementNumber starting 'WMP-') is created AND an agreement_status_updated event is emitted. NOTE: with strict-verbatim wrapping, all current woodland fixtures are rejected because the agreements WMP schema requires applicant.customer.name.{first,last} (the test-data uses customer.firstName/lastName); boundary-minimum-values also lacks business.name, and optional-fields-omitted lacks applicant/payments/totalAgreementPaymentPence. See README.
